current_date: February 2024 (VC1 footer 'Validation Checklist_VC1_February 2024'); approved for adoption by the Environment and Communities Committee on 11 March 2024
current_evidence: The council's 'Local validation checklists' page (last reviewed 31 Dec 2024) links this file as 'VC1 general validation checklist', alongside VC2 householder, VC3 minerals, VC4 waste and the 2024 guidance. It says these were 'approved for adoption by the Council's Environment and Communities Committee at their meeting of 11 March 2024', though the file name and some page text still say 'draft'.

issues.detail: The VC1 contents could not be checked against the source. WebFetch is refused for cheshireeast.gov.uk/pdf/ (robots_disallowed), and the committee copies on moderngov.cheshireeast.gov.uk returned client errors. The issues below come from the council's validation page and from internal evidence in Grokbot's own extraction (source file names, footers and quoted text). Missing VC1 requirements could not be listed. Only about six application-type rows actually come from VC1 (BNG, Landscaping, Heads of Terms, Viability, the Works to trees arb statement), so VC1 coverage looks thin and needs a manual check.

About 14 Full planning rows come from the VC3 minerals and VC4 waste checklists, which apply only to minerals or waste applications. Examples: Agricultural Land Classification/Soils, Coal Mining/Land Stability, Contaminated Land, Drainage Strategy ('All development proposals for waste...'), Energy/Sustainability ('whole life greenhouse gas emissions of the product or process'), Site levels, Flood Risk Assessment, Geotechnical, Highways/Parking (waste), LVIA, Minerals/Waste statements ('its proposed restoration scheme'), Odour/Dust and Pre-application engagement (waste). Meanwhile the Minerals & waste row has only one entry (Drainage).
issues.evidence: Row sources vc3-minerals-validation-checklist-2024.pdf / vc4-waste-validation-checklist-2024.pdf; e.g. 'SUDS Drainage Design / Strategy: All development proposals for waste will be expected to provide...'

issues.detail: Air Quality Assessment is placed under Outline only because the word 'outline' appears as a verb in the guidance text ('...resulting from the proposed development and outline appropriate mitigation'). Nothing in the source makes it outline-specific. The Works to trees row applies the VC1 development tree survey/arboricultural statement to tree works applications, and no source text supports that.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'All Air Quality Assessments should indicate the change in air quality resulting from the proposed development and outline app...'

issues.detail: Grokbot used the superseded 2018 draft checklist (draft-general-validation-checklist-2018-dm-final.docx), which is no longer linked on the council's validation page, for several rows. These are CIL Additional Information form (Full), Design and Access Statement (Full), Public Open Space Statement, Site Waste Management Plan, the Planning Statement rows under Full, Listed building and Change of use, and one tab_item. The planning.data.gov.uk record also still points to this 2018 docx.
issues.evidence: Council page lists only the 2024 guidance, VC1, VC2, VC3 and VC4

issues.detail: The list date 2024-12-01 comes from PDF metadata. The document footer (quoted in Grokbot's own extraction) reads 'Validation Checklist_VC1_February 2024', and the council page says the checklists were approved for adoption on 11 March 2024. December 2024 is only the page's 'last reviewed' date.
issues.evidence: 'approved for adoption by the Council's Environment and Communities Committee at their meeting of 11 March 2024'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments with no actual trigger. Householder Archaeological Assessment is 'LOCAL REQUIREMENTS Archaeological Assessment'. Householder CIL is 'archaeological interest Community infrastructure levy (CIL)'. Full DAS is '/ Website ( DESIGN AND ACCESS STATEMENT'. Full Contaminated Land is 'soakage tests Contaminated Land Assessment for: Validation Checklist_VC3_February 2024'. Viability is 'of the viability assessment Validation Checklist_VC1_February 2024'. Open space is 'applications Public Open Space Statement'. Waste is 'the NPPF Site Waste Management Plan'. Householder Parking runs on into the Structural Survey text. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' is actually minerals soil/ALC restoration text, not a workers' dwelling requirement.

Full planning Noise Impact Assessment, Structural Survey, Ventilation/Extraction, Schedule of works and Floor plans/Elevations quote definitions or drawing advice from the guidance document (e.g. 'Noise Impact Assessment – A technical assessment usually informed by a site specific noise survey...'), not the 'when:' triggers in VC1.

Almost all 16 tab_items are guidance or process text. Examples: the 'bad example of a hand drawing' paragraph, 'The Planning Portal will calculate fees for you...', file types, file naming and the 10mb file size limit, 'contact planning@cheshireeast.gov.uk' for large files, the personal information/redaction paragraphs, 'Please provide a redacted copy. 5 CHESHIRE EAST PLANNING LOCAL VALIDATION CHECKLISTS GUIDANCE 4.' and the procedure paragraphs 2.1-2.4. The one real requirement among them, the waste Odour Management Plan, is filed under 'Submission rules' and runs on into the Parking heading.
issues.evidence: tab_items, sections 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms / checklists'

issues.detail: The 'written justification must be produced by a suitably qualified person(s)' text appears three times in tab_items (2018 docx, 2024 guidance and VC1), and the Planning Statement row is repeated under Full planning, Listed building and Change of use with the same 2018 text.
issues.evidence: 'Where an application is not accompanied by 'Local Checklist' requirements, a written justification must be produced...'

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' in the reference row is just the council homepage, not the validation checklists page.

summary: The link is the current VC1 general checklist (Feb 2024, approved 11 Mar 2024), but the council site blocks automated fetching, so its contents were not verified. Grokbot's extraction mislabels minerals/waste checklist items as Full planning requirements, used the superseded 2018 draft for several rows, put Air Quality under Outline from the verb 'outline', and fills tab_items with process text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
